QF.id: Issue Management - General Obligations and Due Diligence_71

question.text: For a Fast Track Issue (FTI) FPO, what is the minimum average market capitalisation of public shareholding required?

explanation.text: The Logic: For a Fast Track Issue FPO, the minimum average market capitalisation of public shareholding of the listed company must be Rs. 1,000 crore. This is higher than the Rs. 250 crore threshold applicable for fast track rights issues. The Trap: Rs. 250 crore is the threshold for fast track rights issues, not FPOs. Candidates who mix up these two thresholds will pick the wrong answer. Rs. 500 crore is a fabricated middle-ground distractor. Note: The threshold is measured on average market capitalisation of public shareholding — not the average market capitalisation of the listed company as a whole.
